providers.name: Morrow core
providers.test_account_plan: Synthetic two-tenant/local database fixtures; no production authority engine exists.
providers.restrictions: Internal code review, concurrency, isolation, retention and domain qualification.

providers.name: Shopify
providers.test_account_plan: ADR-0022 item 4: one custom-distribution app per beta store, each on a fresh Morrow development store in a Shopify Partner organization; never the owner's live shop or an unrelated store. The owner deploys each app's TOML (npm run shopify-app -- toml), stores its client secret in the broker vault and registers it (npm run shopify-app -- register) under per-action approval; the first install is recorded in docs/evidence/live/. CI uses only the synthetic Shopify oracle.
providers.restrictions: MVP (ADR-0022 items 4-6; ADR-0008 as amended 2026-10-20): custom distribution only, read_products and write_products only, non-expiring offline tokens held as broker-vault envelopes, development stores only until M6, and no public app, App Store review or Shopify App Pricing. The broker hand-writes the query and webhook HMAC, the code exchange and one fixed Admin GraphQL document; the connector binds no secret and uses no Shopify library. Standalone workspace with thin connector controls only; protected data, historical orders, theme exemption, connector classification/UI review and specific billing eligibility remain unqualified.

providers.restrictions: Catalogue models and efforts only (ADR-0022 items 10 and 16), no fallback; no zero-data-retention agreement; retention and training terms per S153-S155; held-out quality and cost evaluation before production.

providers.name: E2B
providers.restrictions: ADR-0029 and ADR-0035 item 6: one fresh sandbox per job (profile morrow.computer v1: internet off at creation, a 900 s lifetime, one 120 s exec as a non-root user, the operation id as its only metadata), never connected to, resumed or paused. E2B_API_KEY binds only to the broker, read only while the runtime switch (docs/decisions/runtime-staging.json, committed off) is on or cleanup-only; the adapter is hand-written fetch with no SDK (build order PR 8). No credential, customer field or id, shop domain or URL enters a sandbox; inputs are minimised extracts and outputs only checked PNG, CSV and XLSX. Every failure after the send mark is an unknown effect, reconciled before any retry under a runtime hold only a person lifts. Qualification (egress denied, the envd token unreadable by the guest user, timeouts that kill without pausing) comes before on; any template, region or adapter change voids it. E2B's data processing terms and deletion answers come before the first outside merchant.
providers.test_account_plan: The E2B project Morrow-staging (Hobby, US-WEST-1) with its US$20 usage limit; the code's runtime budget is US$10 a month, 10 concurrent sandboxes and 3 per workspace (migration 0039). The owner creates the API key and saves it with morrow_put as e2b-api-key, and builds the template with the owner's own E2B login (ADR-0029 owner question 1); Claude, CI and Workers never build it. Pro is bought at production bring-up (owner question 2).

providers.name: Stripe Billing and Stripe Tax
providers.test_account_plan: No Stripe account exists yet (owner actions 1-3 of docs/briefs/M5-billing.md). M5 PR-1 code runs only against the fake Stripe origin of scripts/fixtures/stripe-fake.mjs; the owner creates the test-mode account, restricted key, webhook endpoint (six events, the pinned version), Product, Price and portal configuration under per-action approval, and the first test-mode smoke is recorded in docs/evidence/live/. Live activation needs a legal business entity, a bank account, a tax advisor and tax registrations where required, plus an approved packet and per-action owner approvals.
providers.restrictions: Morrow-direct billing route only (ADR-0015): website-created workspaces that pay before linking a store. Never reachable for a Shopify-route workspace or a workspace with no route that has ever had a store linked (shopifyBoundAt set, never cleared); the API refuses those sessions. No SDK: fixed fetch calls in the broker on the one pinned API version (M5 PR-1), WebCrypto HMAC for webhook signatures. The restricted test key (rk_test_ only) and the webhook signing secret bind only to the broker in development and staging (Security invariant 11; ADR-0022 item 7); production holds them until the ADR-0007 item 9 custody ADR. Morrow is the seller of record and files and remits sales tax and VAT. Stripe billing credits are not the Morrow work-credit ledger. Revenue-share treatment under the Shopify Partner Program Agreement is unresolved.
